draft.emotion: firm and decisive, like putting a hand up to halt someone
notes: To say 'stop doing something', use 'parar de' followed by the infinitive (e.g., 'parar de falar', 'parar de fumar').
The expression 'ir parar em' is very common and means 'to end up in' a place (e.g., 'Como você foi parar lá?').
